gloss: to happen repeatedly; to occur again and again

definitions.gloss: to happen repeatedly; to pile up one after another
definitions.explanation: Of bad events such as failures, mistakes, accidents or complaints: to happen again and again. Most often used before a noun: {度重|たびかさ}なる{失敗|しっぱい}, repeated failures.

examples.japanese: {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}む→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧。
examples.english: I'm discouraged by my repeated failures.

examples.japanese: {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was warned for being late again and again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{度重|たびかさ}なり、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: After one scandal after another, the president finally announced his resignation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{度|たび}→度：03431_tabi⟧ (occasion, time) and ⟦{重|かさ}なる→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧ (to pile up). Almost always describes unwelcome things, and it is a written, formal word typical of apologies and news reports. The attributive form {度重|たびかさ}なる + noun is far more common than the verb at the end of a sentence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧: repeated failures
- {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦{要請|ようせい}→要請：05463_yousei⟧: repeated requests
- {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: one accident after another
- {度重|たびかさ}なる⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧: the repeated trouble (we have caused you; in apologies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相次|あいつ}ぐ→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧: to follow one after another — also for good news; stresses the succession, not the accumulation
